t: You're on Harrington Gardens, a street in Kensington and Chelsea with a garden square. It runs from Collingham Gardens and Collingham Road in the east to Gloucester Road and Stanhope Gardens in the west. Look out for the group of Grade II* listed buildings on the south side, numbers 35 to 45. Several other buildings here are listed too. Edward Guinness, 4th Earl of Iveagh, lived here. He is an Anglo-Irish aristocrat and businessman, and a member of the Guinness family.
